title: Cream Cheese Yukon Potatoes
description: Yukon Gold potatoes cooked in a vacuum bag with cream cheese and butter in the Anova Precision Oven, then mashed right in the bag.

steps.title: Bag
steps.text: Place {potatoes}, {creamcheese}, {butter} and {salt} in a vacuum bag.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Cook in the Anova Precision Oven with Sous Vide Mode on at 194°F, 100% steam, for 3 to 4 hours.

steps.title: Hold
steps.text: When done, reduce the oven to 150 to 160°F and hold until serving time.

steps.title: Mash
steps.text: Remove the bag and mash the potatoes directly in the bag with your hands or a rolling pin.

steps.title: Transfer
steps.text: Open the bag and transfer the potatoes to a serving bowl. Stir briefly until smooth.

notes: Start at 1:00 PM for a 5:30 PM dinner. Mashing in the bag keeps every bit of the buttery cream cheese liquid in the potatoes. Pairs with Chicken Piccata.
